Lord '''Hirare Nachiman''' was an [[Arafellin]] lord, brother of King [[Paitar Nachiman]] and [[Kiruna Nachiman]] [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Green Ajah]].<ref name="comp">''[[The Wheel of Time Companion]]'', Hirare Nachiman.</ref>

==History==
He led the troops of [[Arafel]] during the [[Aiel War]]. {{ref|{{bwb}}, Chapter 14}} He was killed in a skirmish after the [[Battle of the Shining Walls]].
